objects.name: Analytic 1931
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Domain Name System (DNS) queries from Industrial Control System (ICS) host Internet Protocol (IP) addresses to external resolvers for domains not associated with any approved ICS vendor, particularly domains exhibiting Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA)-like patterns. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
